Andrew Pace

The Sport You Need

The place of sport in a life.

Sport can be a place to improve, a routine to return to, and a way to spend time with other people. This book considers that broader role, including the space it can occupy when the objective is not simply to compete at a higher level.

The subject connects to my own experience as an athlete, but the question is wider than competitive tennis: what do we expect from sport, and what kind of practice can fit the rest of a life?
